title: REQ-ARC-WMTE-6010/6011 four-arm world-model verification matrix
model_specs: no model invoked; on-disk engines scored against collected transitions

mask_effect.interpretation: Compare identity_delta to ondisk_delta. The mask raising a ZERO-KNOWLEDGE engine's score by more than a real engine's is the laundering signature, and it is why arm A1 (mask-only) must be labelled 'admits more, INCLUDING degenerates' rather than 'measures better'. REQ-ARC-WMTE-6015's swallow guard removes the worst mechanism (a mask that deletes the game, under which the identity engine is optimal) but does not by itself make the mask neutral.
mask_effect.why_never_negative_is_a_STRUCTURAL_INVAR: Masking can only DELETE cells from a comparison, so an exact-match count can only rise. A negative delta would be a BUG. This check is therefore a bug-detector whose passing value is guaranteed by the code path -- it is NOT an acceptance witness, because it has no reachable failing value on correct code, and presenting it among the gates would be a pass that could not have failed.

admission_counts.interpretation: If the new gate admits 0 real on-disk engines while the incumbent admits a few, the measured effect is 'removes N false admits, adds no true ones'. That is a real improvement in precision and it CANNOT by itself move induction_attempts_planned off 0 -- it moves it further from 0 being caused by a bad admission and closer to 0 being caused by there being no good engine to admit. Say so plainly rather than reporting only the arms closed.

flag_orthogonality.interpretation: The mask repairs the metric REQ-6010 diagnosed (legacy full-grid accuracy) and the new gate then stops using that metric. Where the change_fidelity delta is ~0 on real engines, the mask's decision-level effect is carried entirely by the hand-written control -- so the four-arm design is justified by the CONTROL's mask-sensitivity, not by a confound the real-engine population shows.

summary.FINDING_gate_must_not_ship_without_mask: The must-not-fire control is admitted MASK-ON on every seed and REJECTED MASK-OFF on every seed (change_fidelity 0.4694/0.4083/0.4103 < 0.5 on the whole dc22 corpus, reason change_fidelity_below_threshold). So the gate-only arm (A2) rejects the one engine known to be genuinely good, and CARNOT_ARC_WM_CHANGE_GATE must not be flipped without CARNOT_ARC_WM_HUD_MASK. The two flags are independent constants but NOT independent in the direction that matters for a ship decision.
summary.FINDING_support_is_three_seeds_no_signif: The must-not-fire control and the no-op-hallucination arm are 3 matched seeds each. The minimum two-sided sign-test p at n=3 is 0.25, so NO result on these arms can be significant at any conventional level, and none is claimed. The 3/3 outcomes are reported as illustrative direction, not as established rates. Raising this above illustrative needs n>=10 (min p 0.00195), which is a separate run.

freshness_acknowledgements.reason: The 2026-08-01 attempt-budget fix adds a DEFAULT-OFF flag, CARNOT_ARC_INDUCE_DEFECT_OWNS_ATTEMPTS. With it unset -- the shipped state -- a defect re-ask consumes an attempt exactly as before and the induce loop is behaviourally identical to the path this artifact was produced under. Only with the flag SET does a defect re-ask grant an extra attempt instead of consuming a content attempt.
freshness_acknowledgements.evidence: PROVEN BY TEST, in the direction that matters for this artifact. tests/python/test_arc_defect_gate_attempt_consumption_2026_08_01.py asserts BOTH directions: with the flag OFF the prior behaviour reproduces exactly -- including the bug, so a content-failure sequence still yields zero defect re-asks -- and only with it ON does the gate fire. The OFF assertion is the load-bearing one here: it is what makes the shipped default a true no-op rather than an approximation of one. A clean answer is additionally asserted to cost exactly one call in BOTH modes. No rebuild differential was run for this change and none is claimed.
